# About {.unnumbered}

A worked book for empirical asset pricing using Python Polars and local WRDS
Parquet files. The first chapter reconstructs one portfolio-sort workflow,
inspired by Bali, Engle, and Murray's *Empirical Asset Pricing: The Cross Section
of Stock Returns*. [AnomalyLab](https://github.com/FinPhD/AnomalyLab) is an
independent numerical reference, not a reader dependency.

The first chapter compares implementations on the same input panel. It does
not claim to reproduce a published table or redistribute WRDS data.
